appearance_facts.fact: Segment labeled 'Nuclear (45%)' is the largest, colored orange-red.
Segment labeled 'Hydroelectric (30%)' is the second largest, colored red.
Segment labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' is the third largest, colored yellow.
Segment labeled 'Renewables (10%)' is the smallest, colored orange.

public_definitions: Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
Use the dashboard to determine which energy source is the largest category in global energy consumption for this routing decision.
Priority monitoring route: Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring, Escalate Hydroelectric for priority source monitoring, Keep Renewables on routine source monitoring.
